answer: A single identity may take at most 13% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. The trellis cap is applied at the violet settlement and visible in the knoll breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. Because of that, capturing the pool calls for several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
